# Tioga AI

> Tioga AI is a solo-practitioner consulting firm that builds and governs AI agents inside real enterprise systems — Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, and Workday. Three practices, sixteen priced engagements: automating finance and operations, modernizing ERP with an agent layer, and governing enterprise AI (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act, US state law). Every engagement is fixed-fee with named deliverables, named exclusions, and objective acceptance criteria, and starts with a 5-day, $5,000 Discovery Sprint credited toward the full engagement.

Tioga AI is built and run by one person, not a firm or a team — pages that say "the team" are a copy error, not a description of the org. There are no published client case studies by deliberate policy; the site instead runs live, real demos against Tioga's own infrastructure.

## Practices and offers

- [Services](https://tioga.ai/services): all sixteen priced engagements, grouped into the three practices below, each with price and duration stated up front.
- [Automate finance and operations](https://tioga.ai/solutions/ap-automation): AI Operations Assessment, AI Agent Pilot.
- [Modernize ERP with an agent layer](https://tioga.ai/solutions/governed-write-path): Agent-Ready ERP Diagnostic & Governed Write-Path, Salesforce Governed Write-Path & Evidence Build, Legacy System AI Augmentation, ERP Modernization Advisory.
- [Govern enterprise AI](https://tioga.ai/solutions/ai-governance): AI Governance Readiness Assessment, AI Cost & Model Governance Assessment, Agentic AI Governance Framework, Multi-State AI Compliance Program, ISO 42001 Implementation Sprint, EU AI Act Conformity Program, Fractional AI Governance Officer, and the three Standing Watch tiers (Assessment, Build, Retainer).
- [Standing Watch](https://tioga.ai/solutions/standing-watch): cross-platform AI agent governance that composes evidence across ServiceNow, SAP, Salesforce, and Workday rather than living inside any one vendor's own console.

## Live demos

- [Live demos index](https://tioga.ai/demos): four real, no-signup demos running against real agent infrastructure.
- [Governance Ledger](https://tioga.ai/demos/governance-ledger): real operational spend/routing data from Tioga's own AI gateway, mapped to NIST AI RMF.
- [Standing Watch](https://tioga.ai/demos/standing-watch): real, dated findings from Tioga's own governance automation — including what was auto-fixed and what was correctly left for a human.
- [AP Exception Workflow](https://tioga.ai/demos/ap-exception-workflow): a browser-only invoice-exception simulation (no server calls).
- [Migration Assessment](https://tioga.ai/demos/migration-assessment): a sample Oracle EBS → SAP S/4HANA migration-readiness assessment.
- [MCP connectors](https://tioga.ai/mcp): connector tools demonstrated against mock SAP and Salesforce instances (not live production systems).

## Trust and governance

- [Trust Center](https://tioga.ai/trust): security posture, data handling, and framework alignment, stated plainly including what is not yet in place (no SOC 2 report, no formal uptime SLA).
- [Framework mapping](https://tioga.ai/trust/framework-mapping): how NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and the EU AI Act line up conceptually.
- [EU AI Act exposure](https://tioga.ai/trust/eu-ai-act): timeline and penalty tiers, including the Digital Omnibus deferral (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744).
